quality_guards: Electrical risk depends on voltage, current path, equipment condition, environment, task, isolation, protective devices and worker competence.
HSE electrical evidence is equipment-, installation-, task-, worker-, environment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Construction-dust risk depends on material, silica content, task, duration, control method, extraction performance, respiratory protection and worker susceptibility.
HSE construction-dust evidence is task-, material-, workplace-, control-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Hand-arm-vibration risk depends on tool vibration magnitude, trigger time, grip, posture, maintenance, temperature, work pattern and individual susceptibility.
HSE vibration evidence is tool-, task-, exposure-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Manual-handling risk depends on load, task, posture, frequency, distance, environment, individual capability, aids and work organisation.
HSE manual-handling evidence is load-, task-, worker-, workplace-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Malaria risk depends on destination, season, itinerary, accommodation, bite exposure, parasite resistance, prophylaxis adherence and traveller factors.
UKHSA malaria evidence is destination-, traveller-, itinerary-, prophylaxis-, exposure- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Chikungunya risk depends on destination, season, Aedes activity, local transmission, bite exposure, accommodation, immunity and traveller health.
UKHSA chikungunya evidence is destination-, vector-, traveller-, vaccine-, exposure- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
West Nile risk depends on mosquito species and abundance, bird infection, season, weather, local surveillance, bite exposure and host factors.
UKHSA West Nile evidence is vector-, animal-, location-, person-, surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Yellow-fever risk and vaccine suitability depend on destination, itinerary, outbreak status, age, immune status, medical history and entry requirements.
UKHSA yellow-fever evidence is destination-, traveller-, vaccine-, health-, requirement- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Offshore-helicopter risk depends on aircraft type, sea state, weather, helideck, route, flotation, escape equipment, crew and passenger factors.
CAA offshore-helicopter evidence is aircraft-, operation-, helideck-, weather-, occupant- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Platform-train-interface risk depends on station design, gap and step, dispatch method, crowding, visibility, rolling stock, passenger behaviour and staffing.
ORR platform evidence is station-, platform-, train-, dispatch-, passenger- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level casualty probability.
